report.day_count: synthetic horizon / 365, not a contract settlement calculation
report.penalty_selection: Retained Milestone 3 baseline for every maturity; no maturity-specific tuning
report.strike_rule: 81 equally spaced strikes between F exp(-2.5 sigma sqrt(T)) and F exp(2.5 sigma sqrt(T))
report.display_interpolation: Straight graphical joins only; no fitted intermediate maturities

calendar.scope: Adjacent fitted maturities on a finite normalised-strike grid only

known_calendar.scope: Adjacent fitted maturities on a finite normalised-strike grid only
